references.text: Bezer in the wilderness on the plateau is mentioned as one of the cities of refuge in the tribe of Reuben, the same city assigned to the Levites here.
A parallel passage in Chronicles also mentions Bezer and Jahaz with pasturelands from the tribe of Reuben as cities for the Levites.
Jahaz was the place where the Israelites met Sihon in battle, the city that was later given to the Levites.
Bezer in the wilderness on the high plateau is mentioned as one of the selected cities of refuge east of the Jordan in the tribe of Reuben.
